The bill itself contains provisions which are controversial, as it would establish a system where companies and websites could opt-in and share information with the government. This in and of itself isn't necessarily controversial, but there appear to be very few limits on what information could be shared. From my understanding, almost any information could be sent out to the government. We are currently setting up an emergency livestream to discuss the bill and any potential concerns people may have.
